name: confetti
title: Confetti
description: Paper pieces burst from a point, tumble and flutter down under gravity and air drag, and are gone in under two seconds. Fired by you, from code, at a real moment.

meta.reducedMotion: No particles at all; your success message carries the moment.
meta.useWhen: A genuine, rare success the visitor caused: an order placed, a donation made, a course finished, a wedding RSVP. Once.
meta.avoidWhen: Page load; every button; form validation; serious contexts (payments for bills, health, legal); repeated triggers. For small click feedback use Click Spark.
